name: Dialpad
description: Dialpad cloud phone system as agent tools — call history, transcripts, users, contacts, offices, departments, phone numbers, and SMS. Read-first; send_sms is the single write.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List Dialpad users (name, email, office, on-duty / online status). Optionally filter by email.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get one Dialpad user's full details by user id.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List recent call records (call history). Filter by time window or a target user/office/department id.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Get the full details of a single call by call id.

tools.name: get_call_transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript of a call by call id (when transcription is enabled).

tools.name: list_offices
tools.description: List the offices in the Dialpad company.

tools.name: list_departments
tools.description: List the departments (groups) in the Dialpad company.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the Dialpad company address book.

tools.name: list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers provisioned in the Dialpad company.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS from a Dialpad user to one or more numbers. WRITE action — gate with approval in Eesa RBAC.

roles.label: Dialpad Admin
roles.description: Query calls, transcripts, users and directory; send SMS.

roles.label: Viewer
roles.description: Read-only: calls, transcripts, users and directory.
